tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Cloud Solution Architect | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert | 5+ yrs SAP Hybris
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST API expertise, plus proven design of PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines and micro-service architectures. Hands-on CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, production support and AI-assisted analysis. Techno-functional consultant bridging business requirements and technical delivery in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Cloud Solution Architect (f/m/x)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by NETCONOMY’s focus on innovative, cloud-native e-commerce solutions. With over five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scalable cloud architectures and integration pipelines that align perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: Solution Design
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud architectures, including data-model extensions, OCC REST services and micro-service integrations, ensuring robust, future-proof solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Implemented and customized Hybris 2211 modules, built headless APIs and optimized PIM-to-ERP data flows, directly matching the required SAP Commerce Cloud experience.

bullets.label: Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered PIM/ERP/MDM pipelines using DataHub, Hotfolders and Profisee, delivering seamless product catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Led code reviews, mentored junior developers and drove CI/CD deployments on CCv2, guaranteeing high-quality releases and reliable production support.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als E-Commerce Cloud Solution Architect (f/m/x)
cover_de.hook: Die innovative Ausrichtung von NETCONOMY im Bereich cloud-basierter E-Commerce-Lösungen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen für skalierbare Cloud-Architekturen und Integrationsprozesse mit.

bullets.label: Lösungsdesign
bullets.text: Entwarf ganzheitliche SAP Commerce Cloud Architekturen inkl. Datenmodell-Erweiterungen, OCC-REST-Services und Micro-Service-Integrationen für zukunftssichere Lösungen.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Implementierte und customisierte Hybris 2211-Module, entwickelte Headless-APIs und optimierte PIM-zu-ERP-Datenflüsse – exakt die geforderte Erfahrung.

bullets.label: Integrationsarchitektur
bullets.text: Erstellte PIM/ERP/MDM-Pipelines mit DataHub, Hotfolders und Profisee und gewährleistete nahtlose Katalog-Synchronisation über globale Kanäle.

bullets.label: Führung & Lieferung
bullets.text: Leitete Code-Reviews, mentorierte Junior-Entwickler und steuerte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 für qualitativ hochwertige Releases und stabile Produktion.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, freue mich auf ein Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: NETCONOMY’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge, cloud-first e-commerce projects across Europe aligns with my passion for scalable SAP Commerce solutions. Your collaborative, international environment and focus on innovative architecture provide the ideal platform for me to apply my SAP Hybris expertise and drive high-impact digital commerce transformations for leading brands.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to shape next-generation cloud commerce at NETCONOMY, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to deliver scalable, innovative solutions for global clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to NETCONOMY’s cloud solution architecture. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the E-Commerce Cloud Solution Architect position at NETCONOMY. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and a strong background in cloud architecture and integrations, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
